payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods and resources used to build gazetteer resources from the Wikipedia knowledge base, particularly focusing on Wikidata.

claims.text: Gazetteer resources can be built from the Wikidata knowledge base using entity popularity filtering and enhanced gazetteer embeddings.
Wikipedia's structured knowledge sources can also be used to extract gazetteers, although the data is smaller and noisier compared to Wikidata.
The GazSelfAttn approach utilizes self-attention and match span encoding to create enhanced gazetteer representations for named-entity recognition tasks.
